title: Bitcoin stuck as ETF inflows offset selling, but inflation data could spark a move
summary: Weeks of sideways trading have crushed volatility, leaving Wednesday’s inflation report as the next potential catalyst, analysts said.

title: CFTC orders Kalshi to continue offering prediction markets in New York after state lawsuit
summary: New York sued Kalshi last month in a bid to block it from operating sports-related prediction markets.

title: Brazil's largest lender Itaú is stepping deeper into the tokenization
summary: Itaú Unibanco said it teamed up with tokenization specialist OpenAssets to test tokenized bonds and funds in a pilot run by Brazil's financial watchdog ANBIMA.

title: EToro reports second quarter crypto loss even as total profit beats estimates
summary: The trading platform’s gross crypto revenue fell to $1.35 billion in the second quarter. It also agreed to buy U.S. brokerage TradeZero for up to $231 million.

title: If crypto goes back to the congressional drawing board, 3 Democrat women loom large
summary: The Democrats who may get a bigger say in future crypto legislative efforts are familiar figures, and they generally look at digital assets with distrust.
